claims.statement: DemoCo's cost basis method is FIFO applied wallet by wallet, disclosed under ASC 350-60-50-2.

claims.conclusion: Lot population complete from the subledger.
claims.statement: The lot population at 2025-01-01 is three lots acquired in 2024 totalling 4 BTC with 190,000 USD of basis: L1 and L2 in W-A, L3 in W-B.

claims.conclusion: Relief follows FIFO within the wallet and conserves units.
claims.statement: Disposal D1 relieves L1 in full and 0.5 BTC of L2 under FIFO within wallet W-A, for 105,000 USD of basis; wallet W-B had no disposals.
The realized gain on D1 is 57,500 USD (proceeds 162,500 less basis 105,000).

claims.conclusion: Allocation ties to the pre-2025 lot population.
claims.statement: Under the Rev. Proc. 2024-28 specific unit allocation recorded on 2024-12-20, the 190,000 USD of unused basis on 4 BTC held at 2025-01-01 is allocated 130,000 USD to W-A (3 BTC) and 60,000 USD to W-B (1 BTC); no unit acquired on or after 2025-01-01 is in the allocation.
